title: LinkedIn ad specifications
scope: 14 LinkedIn Marketing Solutions formats: Sponsored Content (single image, carousel, video, document, event, Thought Leader, Article/Newsletter), Sponsored Messaging (conversation, message), Text ads, Lead Gen Forms, CTV, Dynamic Spotlight and Follower. Public documentation only; not account-validated.

records.placement: LinkedIn feed (desktop + mobile; vertical mobile only); LinkedIn Audience Network where enabled
records.source_access: Public page retrieved without login (HTTP fetch of server-rendered HTML); main content transcribed

introductory_text_max.label: Introductory text, maximum
introductory_text_max.value: 3,000 characters; up to 10 emojis; URLs over 23 characters converted to short link

description_max.label: Description, maximum
description_max.value: 300 characters; may vary on LinkedIn Audience Network (LAN)

description_display.label: Description display condition
description_display.value: Shown when image is under 200 px wide or ad serves beyond the feed via LAN

image_alt_text.label: Image alt text (optional)
image_alt_text.value: Supported; only visible to screen-reader users

destination_url.label: Destination URL
destination_url.value: http:// or https:// prefix; up to 2,000 characters (or Lead Gen Form)

vertical_note.label: Vertical delivery
vertical_note.value: Vertical recommended, but paid vertical assets serve on mobile only. 1:1.91 vertical still supported but gets side borders; use 4:5 to avoid borders

thumbnail_ratio.label: Thumbnail rendering
thumbnail_ratio.value: Aspect ratio between 3:2 and 16:9 for optimal thumbnail previews; square/vertical may be cropped when shared organically

file_types.label: File type
file_types.value: JPG, PNG or GIF; animated GIF 250 frames or fewer

image_size_max.label: Image size
image_size_max.value: 7680 x 4320 px; images under 401 px wide display as a thumbnail

horizontal_range.label: Horizontal dimension range
horizontal_range.value: Min 640 x 360 px; max 7680 x 4320 px

square_range.label: Square dimension range
square_range.value: Min 360 x 360 px; max 4320 x 4320 px

vertical_range.label: Vertical dimension range
vertical_range.value: Min 360 x 640 px; max 2430 x 4320 px

records.notes: Business page (single-image-ads-specs) still lists description 70 characters 'LAN only', vertical 1:1.91 at 628 x 1200 and 2:3 at 600 x 900, and no hard maximums for text. Help Center page is the more detailed and more recently maintained source; see source-conflicts.md LI-C1.
